issues.description: Field mismatch for Person.id: the Problem Statement (UML) and the template repository declare Person.id as java.util.UUID, but the solution repository's common Person model declares id as Long. This is inconsistent with the solution server code (PersonService and PersonResource) which treat person identifiers as UUID (e.g. UUID.randomUUID() in PersonService.savePerson and @PathVariable UUID personId in PersonResource.updatePerson). The mismatch will cause compilation/runtime failures and confuses students which identifier type to use for endpoints and model instances.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Person.id type consistent across all artifacts. Preferred fix (preserves exercise intent): change the solution repository's common Person model to use java.util.UUID for the id field (replace Long id with UUID id, update imports and the getter/setter signatures). Verify and recompile so PersonService.savePerson (UUID.randomUUID()) and PersonResource endpoint signatures (@PathVariable UUID personId) use the same UUID type. Alternatively, if Long is desired, update the server code, endpoints, and problem statement/template to use Long everywhere — but ensure a single, consistent identifier type across template, solution, and server.
